settings.title: Collector Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure secure outbound HTTPS telemetry delivery, canonical tenant/site labels, local NS8 metrics, and offline WAL buffering.
settings.hub_section_desc: All metrics (/api/v1/write) and logs (/loki/api/v1/push) are pushed outbound over HTTPS TCP/443.
settings.hub_url_helper: Must start with https:// (without trailing path if hosted at root).
settings.auth_token_keep_helper: Stored token ({prefix}) is active. Leave blank to keep existing token.
settings.tls_skip_verify: Skip Hub TLS certificate verification (lab/staging only)
settings.tls_skip_verify_helper: Keep disabled in production so Hub TLS certificates are strictly verified.
settings.identity_section_desc: Stamped on every metric sample and log stream pushed from this site.
settings.customer_helper: Lowercase alphanumeric slug with hyphens (3-48 chars, matching Hub tenant).
settings.site_helper: Lowercase site identifier (2-48 chars, e.g. hq, dc1, branch-munich).
settings.collector_id_helper: Auto-generated from customer, site, and module ID if left empty.
settings.telemetry_section_title: Local NS8 Telemetry & LAN Syslog Receiver
settings.telemetry_section_desc: Control local host/backup scraping and optional unprivileged UDP/TCP Syslog ingestion.
settings.collect_local_ns8: Collect local NethServer 8 metrics, Restic backups, containers, and journal logs
settings.collect_local_ns8_helper: Reads /proc, /sys, /, and /var/log/journal read-only plus ns8.prom textfile metrics.
settings.enable_syslog_receiver: Enable unprivileged LAN Syslog receiver (RFC5424 UDP & TCP)
settings.enable_syslog_receiver_helper: Publishes the configured port on the NS8 node for LAN firewalls, switches, NAS, and UPS devices.
settings.wal_section_desc: Buffers metrics and logs to local disk during WAN outages and replays automatically upon reconnection.
settings.wal_max_disk_mb_helper: Bounded between 128 MiB and 32768 MiB (excluded from Restic cluster backups).
settings.saved_description: Collector configuration and Grafana Alloy services have been updated.

settings.validation_invalid_site: Use 2-48 lowercase letters, digits, or internal hyphens.

about.title: About Central Monitoring Collector
about.description: Rootless NethServer 8 site collector built on Grafana Alloy v1.4.2 and Proxmox VE Exporter for secure multi-tenant MSP monitoring.
about.feature_zero_wan: Outbound HTTPS push (TCP/443) — zero inbound firewall port-forwards required at customer sites.
about.feature_local_ns8: Zero-touch local NethServer 8 host, mdadm RAID, Restic backup, container, and systemd monitoring.
about.feature_lan_discovery: Agentless LAN scraping for Proxmox VE, SNMP v2c/v3 network/UPS/NAS hardware, Windows/Linux servers, and Syslog.
about.feature_wal_resilience: Local Write-Ahead-Log buffering survives internet outages without losing telemetry.
